comparable.client: kafka-verifiable-producer.sh 4.3.2 (JVM), the same invocation against both systems; reads by kafka-console-consumer.sh

crash_modes.flakey-drop: SIGKILL of all three nodes at once, then every write the page cache had not flushed is dropped (dm-flakey drop_writes): power loss of the whole replica set
crash_modes.sigkill: SIGKILL of all three nodes at once (the host's page cache survives)

comparable.host_instance: Apple Inc. Apple Virtualization Generic Platform
producer_props: every other producer setting at the client default

profiles.kafka-defaults: Kafka as shipped: no flush.messages, an acknowledgement is replication
profiles.kafka-fsync-parity: log.flush.interval.messages=1 on every broker and flush.messages=1 on the topic
profiles.vtop-shipped: node configuration as shipped: acknowledged after a quorum (2 of 3) has fsynced; answers both Kafka profiles

comparable.simulation_limits: page-cache loss of one host for all three replicas at once; not a drive whose volatile cache lies about flushes, not a torn block, not independent crashes; the kernel can flush a little more between the kill and the drop (kill_to_drop_ms)

topology.kafka: 3 KRaft combined broker+controller nodes, RF=3, min.insync.replicas=2
topology.vtop: static range leader with the Kafka gateway plus two followers, quorum 2 of 3 (compose.vtop.yml); no metadata plane, so no election after the restart

events.event: stopped before crash 2 of vtop-shipped/sigkill: another crash would pass --max-hours (0.21 h). --check lists what is owed; --resume continues.

label: single Linux host, Docker Engine; indicative, not a production benchmark
